title: Web UI document pipeline workspace

context.summary: Add the supported Web UI workspace for document upload, pipeline observation, retry/reprocess actions and artifact source refs.
context.background: TASK-126 created the browser UI foundation with connection, health and project/session navigation. The public-ready plan requires document pipeline operations before search/context/memory/faces and diagnostics UI work.

in: Add HTTP API support needed by the UI to list derived artifacts for a document.
Extend the UI API client with document upload/list/detail, processing run list, artifact list, job list/retry and document recompute calls.
Add a Documents workspace tab with upload, document list/detail, job progress, retry/reprocess controls and artifact/source-ref inspection.
Add loading, empty, authentication, authorization and generic error states for document pipeline operations.
Add UI document workspace validation and include it in pnpm check.
Update README, API docs, UI docs, support matrix, repository status and changelog.
out: Unified search, context, memory and faces UI, which is TASK-128.
Runtime settings and diagnostics UI, which is TASK-129.
Docker image/service and installer routing integration, which is TASK-130.
New document pipeline backend processors or schema changes.

acceptance_criteria: The UI can upload a document through POST /v1/documents using multipart FormData.
The UI can list documents, select a document and show document metadata, processing runs, recent document jobs and derived artifacts.
The UI exposes retry for failed document jobs and reprocess for a selected document through HTTP API calls only.
Derived artifacts show artifact type, run id, model metadata, content/storage summary and source refs.
The API exposes GET /v1/documents/:id/artifacts with project-scoped access control.
pnpm check includes a document workspace validator, and docs describe the new supported UI surface.

manual_checks: Open the UI locally and confirm the Documents tab renders without browser console errors when the API is unavailable.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
